note: Read 2026-11-01 at the owner's word ("Build those first 3 starting with ledger first"; of the 21 countries read first: "It should cover across every country"; "Retry the blocked tax facts once all countries land"): the tax on a screen worker's pay in Bangladesh: a resident's income tax, social contributions, what is withheld at source, a non-resident artiste's withholding, an author's treatment, VAT and the tax year. Research and retry subagents (workbench/briefs/BRIEF-tax.md, BRIEF-tax-retry.md), every quote checked by the lead against its saved page.

figures.finding: For income years 2025-26 and 2026-27 a resident pays nothing up to the tax-free threshold (BDT 400,000 for most; 450,000 for women and those 65 or older), then 10% on the next 300,000, 15% on the next 400,000, 20% on the next 500,000, 25% on the next 2 million and 30% above.
figures.applies: FY 2025/26 and 2026/27 (a 35% top band is legislated from 2027/28); brackets shown for the general threshold. Primary: the Finance Act 2026 (in force 1 July 2026) sets these bands and the BDT 400,000 / 450,000 thresholds for tax years 2026-27 and 2027-28 (income years 2025-26 and 2026-27), with a 35% band above BDT 3.0 crore and higher thresholds from tax year 2028-29.

The basic exemption limit for general taxpayers is BDT 400,000. The basic exemption limit for women and senior citizens aged 65 years or older is BDT 450,000.

figures.finding: The income year runs from 1 July to 30 June; a return may be filed during the following tax year, with a 5% rebate (up to BDT 25,000) for filing by 30 September and surcharges after 31 December.

sources.said: The income year in Bangladesh for an individual is 1 July to 30 June.
1 July - 30 September Rebate of 5% of tax liability (maximum BDT 25,000) 1 October - 31 December No rebate / additional tax

figures.finding: There is no general social-security tax; where a provident fund applies, the employee contributes 7% to 8% of salary and the employer matches.
figures.applies: Establishments covered by the Bangladesh Labour Act 2006.

sources.said: Employees (including foreign nationals) working with an establishment in Bangladesh to which the social security regulations apply are liable to contribute towards the provident fund at the fixed rate of 7% to 8% of salary.

figures.finding: A professional or consultancy fee paid to a resident individual is withheld at 15%; salaries are taxed at source by the employer.

sources.said: Advisory or consultancy services and professional services - payment to individual 15%

figures.finding: Payments to a non-resident artist, singer or player bear 30% withholding; a non-resident's salary 30%, professional services 20% and royalties 20%.

sources.said: Artist, singer, or player 30.00 Salary or remuneration 30.00
Advisory or consultancy service and professional service - individual 20.00
Royalty, license fee, or payments related to intangibles 20.00

figures.finding: VAT is 15% for most goods and services; registration is required once turnover exceeds BDT 5 million.

sources.said: The standard VAT rate in Bangladesh is 15% for the majority of goods and services.
VAT registration is to be obtained once turnover exceeds 5 million Bangladeshi takas (BDT).

figures.finding: No special relief for authors' fees or royalties was found in the Income Tax Act 2023 or its Sixth Schedule; whoever pays a royalty or copyright fee deducts 10% at source (12% where the base exceeds BDT 25 lakh).
figures.applies: Royalties and copyright payments to residents (Income Tax Act 2023 s. 91); the Sixth Schedule (exemptions) has no author-specific entry.
